CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content in the report.

COD.rationale: Content (red) and its presentation/status (origin completed_record) are both explicitly recorded for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content referents and an attribute with coordinate values.

D.rationale: The origin/status field is recorded separately from the content attribute, distinguishing content identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: The entry records how the content is presented/represented (as a completed_record) for the given referent/time.
